# Speak Up Malaysia

> A boutique DEIB consulting firm specializing in workplace ethics, organizational culture transformation, and harassment prevention across Asia and beyond.

Speak Up Malaysia provides comprehensive consulting services in diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB), alongside corporate ethics training and workplace investigations. The firm operates with a philosophy centered on psychological safety, power dynamics awareness, and business integrity.

## Key Topics

- DEIB Consulting
- Workplace Ethics
- Psychological Safety
- Harassment Prevention
- Corporate Governance
- Business Integrity
- Organizational Culture
- Inclusion & Belonging
- Workplace Culture
- Power Dynamics
- Compliance Ethics
- Whistleblowing Programs
- Organizational Transformation
- Sexual Harassment Prevention
- Speak Up Philosophy
